name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Delays button presses/releases by a configurable number of physics ticks (F6 cycles 2/2, 4/4, 8/8, 16/8, OFF) and shows a live console.

show-console.name: Show live console
show-console.description: Opens the 'Geode Predictive Input Buffer - Live Console' window on startup. Requires a game restart.

verbose-log.name: Verbose input log
verbose-log.description: Print every buffered input and when it is applied.
